$comment: Pages for the screens reference (npm run screens). Each entry renders at phone (390px) and desktop (1440px). 'shots' adds extra captures further down the page, each starting at the first element matching its selector. 'prefs' sets the reader's stored settings (stromata:reader) before load. Keep this list to the pages a reader actually lands on or moves through; every entry costs a render against the live database. 'canvas' ({col,row,label?}) and 'links' ([{to, event, from: [...]}]) place a page on the site canvas (npm run screens:canvas): each link says which Umami `from` values carry clicks of that event from this page to `to`. Shape and checks: scripts/lib/site-canvas.mjs.
